operations.summary: Adds or removes subscribers from the blocklist based on an SQL expression or subscriber identifiers. Provide the expression as plain text or use a JSON body to specify `query`, `ids`, and any applicable `action`, `target_list_ids`, or `status` filters.

operations.summary: Creates a campaign from the campaign details supplied in the request body. Provide fields such as `name`, `subject`, and `lists` to define the campaign; all body fields are optional in the schema. A successful response contains the new campaign object.
operations.description: handles campaign creation

operations.summary: Submits updated content for a campaign and converts it to the campaign's content format. Use the campaign identifier in the path and provide any campaign content fields you want to submit.

parameters.description: ID of campaign that you choose to create content

operations.summary: Creates a mailing list from the supplied list details. Provide `name`, `type`, `optin`, `tags`, or `description` as needed; `type` and `optin` have defined accepted values. The response includes the created list and its metadata.
operations.description: handles list creation

operations.summary: Creates a subscriber from the supplied subscriber details. The request body may be omitted, and no fields are required by the schema; include values such as `email`, `name`, or `lists` to set subscriber data.
operations.description: handles creation of new subscriber

operations.summary: Creates a new template. Supply `name`, `type`, and `body`; choose `type` from `campaign`, `campaign_visual`, or `tx`, and include `subject` or `body_source` when relevant to that template type.
operations.description: handles template creation

operations.summary: Deletes a single bounce identified by its ID in the URI. Supply the integer `id` of the bounce you want to remove.
operations.description: handles bounce deletion, either a single one (ID in the URI), or a list.

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: The id value of the bounce you want to delete.

operations.summary: Deletes bounce records selected by a deletion flag or bounce identifiers. Use `all` to indicate bulk deletion or `id` to provide the bounce identifiers to delete.

parameters.description: flag for multiple bounce record deletion

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: list of bounce ids to delete

operations.summary: Deletes campaign analytics of the specified type. Use `before_date` to set the date cutoff for the analytics to remove.

parameters.description: type of GC collected subscribers

operations.summary: Deletes the campaign identified by `id`. Use the campaign's integer identifier to select the campaign to remove. The response contains a boolean result.
operations.description: deletes specified campaign

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: The id value of the campaign you want to get.

operations.summary: Deletes orphaned or blocklisted subscribers through garbage collection. Specify the subscriber category to collect with the `type` path parameter.
operations.description: garbage collects (deletes) orphaned or blocklisted subscribers.

parameters.name: type
parameters.description: type of GC collected subscribers

operations.summary: Deletes a mailing list identified by its ID in the URI. Supply the list's integer `list_id` to specify which list to remove.
operations.description: handles list deletion, either a single one (ID in the URI), or a list.

parameters.name: list_id
parameters.description: The id value of the lists you want to delete.

operations.summary: Deletes an uploaded media record. Supply the media identifier for the record you want to remove.
operations.description: handles deletion of uploaded media.

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: The id value of the list you want to delete.

operations.summary: Deletes the bounce records associated with a specific subscriber. Supply the subscriber's numeric `id` to identify whose bounce records to delete.
operations.description: deletes a subscriber's bounce records

parameters.description: subscriber id

operations.summary: Deletes a subscriber identified by its path parameter. Use the subscriber's integer `id` to select the record to remove.
operations.description: handles subscriber deletion based on id

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: The id value of the subscriber you want to get.

operations.summary: Deletes one or more subscribers identified by the `id` query parameter. Supply the subscriber ID or IDs as a string, with each ID identifying a subscriber to delete.
operations.description: handles subscribers deletion

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: subscriber id/s to be deleted

operations.summary: Deletes subscribers selected by an SQL expression or subscriber identifiers. Provide the expression as plain text or use a JSON body to specify `query`, `ids`, and any applicable `action`, `target_list_ids`, or `status` filters.
operations.description: bulk deletes based on an arbitrary SQL expression.

operations.summary: Deletes subscribers selected by an SQL expression or subscriber identifiers. Provide the expression as plain text or use a JSON body to specify `query`, `ids`, and any applicable `action`, `target_list_ids`, or `status` filters.
operations.description: bulk deletes based on an arbitrary SQL expression.

operations.summary: Deletes a template by its identifier. Use this operation when you no longer need the template; the response indicates whether the deletion succeeded.
operations.description: handles deletion of templates

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: The id value of the template you want to delete.

operations.summary: Deletes unconfirmed subscriptions through garbage collection. Use `before_date` to set the cutoff date for the subscriptions to remove.
operations.description: garbage collects (deletes) orphaned or blocklisted subscribers.

operations.summary: Retrieves a subscriber's profile and related activity data for export. Supply the subscriber's numeric `id` to retrieve profile details, subscriptions, campaign views, and link clicks.

parameters.description: The id value of subscriber profile you want to export

operations.summary: Retrieves a bounce record by its identifier. Supply the record's numeric `id` to look up the bounce you want to retrieve.

operations.summary: Lists uploaded media. Use this endpoint to retrieve the available media records and their file details.

parameters.description: Campaign IDs to get stats for.

operations.summary: Adds, removes, or unsubscribes subscribers from lists based on an SQL expression or subscriber identifiers. Provide the expression as plain text or use a JSON body to specify `query`, `ids`, and the applicable `action`, `target_list_ids`, or `status` filters.
operations.description: bulk adds/removes/unsubscribes subscribers from one or more lists based on an arbitrary SQL expression.

operations.summary: Sends a stop signal to the subscriber importer. Use this endpoint to request that an ongoing import stop.

parameters.description: ID of campaign that you want to test

operations.summary: Renders an HTML preview of a campaign using the supplied template and content fields. Use `id` to identify the campaign and provide the preview inputs as form-encoded fields. The request body fields are optional in the schema.
operations.description: renders the HTML preview of a campaign body

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: The id value of the campaign you want to get the preview of

operations.summary: Updates settings stored in the database. Supply the settings fields you want to update; each listed field is optional.
operations.description: returns updated settings from the DB.

operations.summary: Replaces subscriber data for the subscriber identified by the path parameter. The request body may be omitted, and the schema does not require any fields; supply the subscriber properties you want included in the update.
operations.description: modify subscriber data

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: The id of subscriber to update

operations.summary: Replaces a template's configuration. Supply the template properties you want to set, and use `type` to choose campaign, visual campaign, or transactional template behavior.
operations.description: handles template modification

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: The id value of the template you want to update.

operations.summary: Uploads a media file. Send the file as a binary value using `multipart/form-data`; the request body schema does not define additional metadata fields.
operations.description: handles media file uploads.
